 Convert peak/noise value to log10 value in 0.1dB Since, val = log2(|.|)* 2^Qformat = log10(|.|) / log10(2) * 2^Qformat Equation: output = 1/0.1 * 10log10(|.|^2) = 10 * [ val * 20log10(2) / 2^Qformat ] = val * 6.0 / 2^Qformat * 10.
